sentences.text: TD Garden , often called `` Boston Garden '' and `` The Garden '' , is a multi-purpose arena in Boston .	Boston	Boston	arena	arena	Boston Garden	Boston Garden
It is named after its sponsor , TD Bank , a subsidiary of Canada 's Toronto-Dominion Bank .	TD Bank	TD Bank, N.A.	Toronto-Dominion Bank	Toronto-Dominion Bank
It opened in 1995 as a replacement for the original Boston Garden and has been known as Shawmut Center , FleetCenter , and TD Banknorth Garden .	Boston	Boston	Boston Garden	Boston Garden

TD Garden is the home arena for the Boston Bruins of the National Hockey League and the Boston Celtics of the National Basketball Association .	Boston	Boston	Boston Celtics	Boston Celtics	Boston Bruins	Boston Bruins	Basketball	Basketball	arena	arena	National Hockey League	National Hockey League	National Basketball Association	National Basketball Association
It is owned by Delaware North , whose CEO , Jeremy Jacobs , also owns the Bruins .	Delaware North	Delaware North	Jeremy Jacobs	Jeremy Jacobs
It is the site of the annual Beanpot college hockey tournament , and hosts the annual Hockey East Championships .	Beanpot	Beanpot (ice hockey)	Hockey East	Hockey East

The arena has also hosted many major national sporting events including the 1999 and 2003 NCAA Division I Men 's Basketball regional first and second rounds , the 2009 and 2012 Sweet Sixteen and Elite Eight , the 1998 Frozen Four , the 2004 Frozen Four , the 2014 United States Figure Skating Championships , the 2006 Women 's Final Four , and the 2015 Frozen Four .	Basketball	Basketball	arena	arena	NCAA Division I	NCAA Division I	1998 Frozen Four	1998 NCAA Division I Men's Ice Hockey Tournament	2004 Frozen Four	2004 NCAA Division I Men's Ice Hockey Tournament	2014 United States Figure Skating Championships	2014 United States Figure Skating Championships	2015 Frozen Four	2015 NCAA Division I Men's Ice Hockey Tournament

It hosted games 3 , 4 , and 6 of the 2011 Stanley Cup Finals and the 2013 Stanley Cup Finals for the Bruins , and games 1 , 2 , and 6 of the 2008 NBA Finals and games 3 , 4 , and 5 of the 2010 NBA Finals for the Celtics .	NBA	National Basketball Association	2011 Stanley Cup Finals	2011 Stanley Cup Finals	2013 Stanley Cup Finals	2013 Stanley Cup Finals	2008 NBA Finals	2008 NBA Finals	2010 NBA Finals	2010 NBA Finals
